In a word, she was a narcissist.
The kind who looks at their own face in the mirror and gets lost staring at it.
You know people like that, right?
They're not even that cute or good-looking, but they never budge from in front of the mirror.
She was that type.
The mirror just turned into a painting, that's all.
Yeah, I can say it for sure.
It's not that she wanted to show me her paintings.
She painted self-portraits and looked at them because she wanted to admire herself.
Whether I was there or not didn't matter one bit.
After all, the only paintings she'd ever show me were the ones she painted of herself.{p}

I got sleepy, too.
I was only in junior high, after all.
By the time I rubbed my drowsy eyes and looked at the clock with my head all foggy, it was already past midnight.
That was way too late, any way you look at it.
I was just thinking, how on earth could the parents allow that, when he finally came out.{p}
